summary: Backend fully verified for App Version policy + Archive bulk/undo. All 10 pytest tests in test_app_version_and_archive_bulk.py + test_restore_archive.py pass (10/10, exit 0). Public /api/app/version-policy returns defaults w/o updated_by_email; admin GET/PUT /api/admin/app-version enforce 401/403 without token, validate version format (abc -> 400), min<=latest (2.0.0>1.5.0 -> 400) and https-only links (http -> 400) with string detail; blanks fall back to defaults. Bulk endpoints dismiss-bulk, undo and restore-bulk return correct removed/skipped/undone/restored counts and persist. Validation (missing/empty/non-list/501 names -> 400) and auth gate verified. Policy was reset to blank at the end so preview is NOT blocked. Frontend UI testing was impeded by first-run gates (Age gate 'I’m 13 or older' + Language picker 'Continue'); after bypassing those via localStorage, the subsequent UI login round-trip hit a transient form reset (likely in-memory login rate limit from earlier attempts), so admin UI flows (Profile -> App Version screen, banner, blocking screen, Restore modal select/undo) were not interactively verified. The main agent already confirmed the pytest layer earlier; frontend-only coverage should be re-validated after a backend restart to clear the login rate limiter.
action_items: Frontend UI flows (Profile -> App Version CTA, banner for non-admin at latest=9.0.0, blocking screen at min=latest=9.0.0, Restore modal select mode + bulk remove/restore + undo, single remove + undo) were NOT verified in-browser this run because the Expo web preview's login kept resetting (likely 429 rate limit from earlier attempts). Please `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` then self-test, OR re-run the testing agent after the limiter cools down.

Agent-to-agent context said the Age gate button is 'Continue' but on the live preview it's 'I’m 13 or older' / 'I’m under 13' (per age_gate.adult_button in translations.ts). Please update the hand-off note so future testing agents don't collide with 'Continue with Google' on the auth form.
No code changes required; version policy was reset to blank (confirmed via GET /api/app/version-policy returning empty min/latest + default store links).
critical_code_review_comments: AppVersionGate: admin bypass logic looks correct (required && !user?.is_admin branches into the blocking Modal, otherwise falls through to the banner with admin_bypass copy).
routes/app_version.py: _vtuple pads to 3 ints and _VERSION_RE allows 1-3 numeric groups — matches the frontend's compareVersions semantics ('1.2' == '1.2.0').

RestoreDancesModal (instructor.tsx:3223+): single Remove deliberately skips confirm and relies on the 6s Undo bar — matches the request. confirmThen uses globalThis.confirm on web, so page.on('dialog', accept) is required to drive bulk flows.
